A snowy, mountainous landscape is shown with glowing blue lines carved into the rocks and the text 'THE DEADLANDS' overlaid. A glowing blue circular symbol shines above a cracked, rocky cliff face in the snow.
panels.dialogue: TOWER, FLOOR 8. THE DEADLANDS

panels.narration: Two armored figures stand on the snowy ground with the blue symbol glowing behind them. White space with a large blue slash sound effect indicating impact

panels.narration: A trench-coated man stands on a snowy ledge raising his arm, watched by two soldiers. Two armored soldiers stand back-to-back in the snow with large SFX text in the foreground. A large black SFX mark appears on a white background below the snowy scene.
panels.dialogue: Fuu 터져!

panels.narration: The upper portion of a panel is white, containing two overlapping speech bubbles. The top of a blonde-haired man's head is visible against a snowy background. A grey-haired man in a heavy, dark hooded coat glares with a cold expression in the falling snow. A text box identifies the character as the Rank 6 Blue Zone Guildmaster, Kyojo Itsuki.
panels.dialogue: TODAY, WE'RE HERE TO DO THE UNPRECEDENTED. TO TAKE DOWN THE 8TH FLOOR'S GUARDIAN. RANK 6 BLUE ZONE GUILDMASTER KYOJO ITSUKI

panels.narration: Several armored soldiers hold spears in formation. Two speech bubbles contain dialogue. A knight in dark armor grips the pommel of their sword tightly.
panels.dialogue: BECAUSE THIS IS A COALITION RAID. IF WE DON'T CLEAR THIS, FLOOR 9 STAYS A FANTASY.

panels.narration: Sharp, metallic sounds repeat against a plain white background. A soldier in a fur-trimmed coat and armor looks on as other armed figures stand in the snow, ending with a surprised reaction.
panels.dialogue: Clink Clink Clink !

panels.narration: A white speech bubble hangs in a snowy sky against a black background. A close-up of a man's intense face with dark hair and a headband in the snow.
panels.dialogue: ...LOOK WHO SHOWED UP.

panels.narration: A white speech bubble hangs in a snowy sky against a black background. The group stands together in the snow, ready for action. A close-up shows legs walking through snow, flanked by soldiers in heavy furs.
panels.dialogue: BLUE EYES THEMSELVES.

panels.narration: A close-up shows a black-haired man in a dark mask and heavy fur coat standing in falling snow. A dark, close-up shot focuses on the back of a person in a heavy fur-collared coat.

RANK 1
BLUE EYES
GUILDMASTER
NARUKAMI SUBARU ドワッ

panels.narration: A speech bubble appears in a white space, apologizing for the delay.
panels.dialogue: SORRY FOR THE HOLD-UP.

panels.narration: The blonde guildmaster smiles as he faces a man in a yellow-faced mask. The masked man and the smiling guildmaster shake hands in the snow. A speech bubble appears in the white space below.
panels.dialogue: Jin HOLD-UP? YOU'RE LITERALLY THE FIRST ONES HERE.

panels.narration: A group of adventurers and soldiers stand on the battlefield while others watch in the foreground.
panels.dialogue:
I HEARD EVEN THE MARTIAL CLANS ARE JOINING IN TODAY.
THE NARUKAMI SUBARU IS LEADING THE CHARGE, AFTER ALL.
THEY PROBABLY JUST WANNA GRAB WHATEVER SCRAPS YOU LEAVE BEHIND.

panels.narration: A man in a black jacket grips a device tightly with both hands in a snowy environment. A gloved hand grips the hilt of a sword in a snowy, dark environment.
panels.dialogue: IF THEY'RE AFTER SCRAPS... Kya

panels.narration: A masked man with black hair and a blonde man face each other in a glowing corridor. Two men in winter coats grip each other's hands in the falling snow. A close-up shows one of their gloved hands receiving a glowing, heart-shaped object.
panels.dialogue: I'VE GOT ONE RIGHT HERE. ...?

A young man in dark armor stares down in shock while holding a glowing red heart-shaped emblem with white wings. The tail of a speech bubble is visible at the top edge of the frame. A blank white background contains two overlapping speech bubbles. A dark-haired man in a dark coat stands with his back to the viewer while a blonde man in armor looks up with concern in the snow. A man in a heavy coat faces a dark figure in the snow and speaks. A tall, dark panel containing speech bubbles against a white background. A masked figure with black hair faces a blonde man in a snowy landscape.

A figure in a gold-accented plague doctor mask stands in the rain next to a frightened brown-haired man. A close-up shows a figure with a fur-lined collar in the rain, accompanied by a sudden exclamation bubble.
panels.dialogue: Swish !!

panels.narration: A blonde man looks up with a worried expression in the snow, saying 'It's here' while a dark-haired figure stands to his side. A blonde man in a fur-lined coat stands nervously beside a dark-haired figure wearing a gold-trimmed mask as snow falls around them.
panels.dialogue: IT'S HERE. IT'S SHOWING ITSELF THIS EARLY?!

panels.narration: A large glowing symbol cuts across the scene as soldiers and a shouting warrior react to the revelation of the Floor 8 Guardian. A group of men in winter armor look down in panic as a bright streak of light plunges toward them. An empty white speech bubble appears against a rainy background. A brown-haired man in a dark trench coat screams in anguish as rain falls on him. A massive glowing blue claw strikes down through the air. A massive armored figure emerges surrounded by glowing blue energy. A massive multi-headed beast looms over a blue-haired man standing on the battlefield. A figure unleashes a glowing blue energy attack with intense speed lines.
panels.dialogue: FLOOR 8 GUARDIAN BRACE FOR IMPACT!!! VENOM DRAGON HYDRA

panels.narration: A speech bubble declares an insult against the creature. A masked man with spiky dark hair stands in the falling snow.
panels.dialogue: NASTY-LOOKING BASTARD.

panels.narration: A black-gloved hand reaches down with glowing yellow energy spreading across the ground as dark tendrils swirl. Lightning cracks across a dark backdrop as a masked figure with a glowing blue eye emerges below a digital caption box. A close-up of a man in dark tactical armor and yellow pants, holding a sword on a cracked, dusty ground. A large speech bubble is superimposed over a dark background, declaring a fatal threat.
panels.dialogue: IT MAKES MY SKIN CRAWL... LIGHTNING SURGES THROUGH SUBARU'S ENTIRE BODY. TODAY'S THE DAY YOU DIE.

panels.narration: A white space features dark red claw marks striking the center. A masked figure with glowing red eyes looks down ominously.
Glowing green blades slash through the air. A monstrous dragon with glowing eyes roars as green energy slashes through its body.
A blond man falls on his back in the rain while shouting a warning to others. A close-up shows a hand gripping a weapon with a sharp impact effect nearby.
panels.dialogue: IT'S GONNA UNLEASH ITS BREATH! EVERYONE, FALL BACK!!! NO NEED.
